$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.scan. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-REGION-TERM-OFF
arms.note: no region owns the terminator after its `#end`, so a fix moving the region drops it and `empty-statement` deletes it

arms.name: M-DECL-NULLABLE-OVERRIDES-EXISTS
arms.note: the written annotation is consulted even where the initializer already had a verdict, so a map read an `m.exists(k)` guard proved present is seeded MaybeNull again through its `Null<V>` declaration

arms.name: M-SAFENAV-NO-NARROW
arms.note: a `?.` guard narrows nothing, so `if (u?.b != null) u.b.c()` reports its own guarded dereference again

arms.name: M-RENDER-SPAN-TOKENS
arms.note: no byte is ever inside a token, so the display renderer collapses whitespace INSIDE a string literal again and a finding advertises a call the fix would not write

arms.name: M-TERMINAL-RUNGS-ANY
arms.note: every assignment r-value answers as a ternary tail, so the widened gate claims sites that belong to prefer-ternary-assignment

arms.name: M-EXISTS-GUARD-BLIND
arms.find:
final kind: String = cond.kind;
		if (kind == combineKind) {
arms.note: no exists-guard fact is ever established, so every map read under `m.exists(k)` is reported point-wise and seeded MaybeNull again

arms.name: M-GUARDED-USING-ABSENT
arms.note: a `using` a `#if` region guards is invisible again, so every rule sharing the insert seam splices a SECOND, unguarded one beside it

arms.name: M-USING-INSERT-COVERED-SILENT
arms.note: an insert the accepted edits already cover is dropped while the helper still answers `true`, so every rule sharing it keeps a rewritten extension call with no `using` to bind it

arms.name: M-USING-SCOPE-EMPTY-OFFSETS-INSCOPE
arms.note: an empty offset list reads as coverage again, so a caller deciding the insert before it has collected its sites is told the guarded `using` covers them all

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-REPORT-INDEX-DELETE
arms.note: the ONE name-keyed reflection scope collapses to the report files again, so a `Reflect.field(x, 'name')` in a file the run does not lint contributes nothing: the autofix DELETES the member that reflective read still names, and the rename orphans it

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-SCOPE-PROJECT-ONLY
arms.note: the T868 fork put back: the name-keyed reflection scope narrows to report UNION resolutionRoots, so a reflective string in the LIBRARY half of the very same declared scope stops counting and the two halves answer differently

arms.name: M-NON-NULL-RHS-DROP-HEX
arms.note: the hexadecimal literal leaves the last hand-written list of the literal vocabulary. The side-effect-free and root vocabularies are now DERIVED from the same declaration the differential reads, so cutting one of those is unfalsifiable; this list is a second, independent spelling and is exactly where the original HexLit gap lived

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-MEMO-DEAD
arms.note: the run-scoped memo is never consulted, so every one of the five checks sharing the reflection gate walks the whole scope again — the state before S192, and the half that makes the staleness cell beside it vacuous if nobody pins it

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-MEMO-STALE
arms.note: the memo answers without checking the sources it read, so a scope file a `--fix` pass has just rewritten — or a second, different scope in the same run — is answered from the earlier text: the reflective read a pass introduced stops vetoing, and the next rewrite orphans it silently

arms.name: M-REFLECTION-UNREADABLE-BLIND
arms.note: the name-keyed reflection gate goes blind to a scope file the parser could not read, so `inline-constant` erases a constant whose `Reflect.field` read lives in an unparseable sibling — T867's residue, reachable only once the fixture selects its cells by the FORM of the evidence (T921)

arms.name: M-ISVAR-ACCESSOR-BODY-BLIND
arms.note: accessor bodies are never read, so the fix strips the metadata from a property whose get_x / set_x, or a subclass override of one, reads or writes the field

arms.name: M-ISVAR-BYPASS-BLIND
arms.note: an @:bypassAccessor construct is never read, so the fix strips the metadata from a field a bypass access still reaches

arms.name: M-ISVAR-OPAQUE-BLIND
arms.find: if (CondRegionScan.opaqueCondRegionMentioning(tree, entry.source, name, ctx.shape) != null) return true;
arms.note: an unparsed `#if` region spelling the name is trusted as empty, although nothing inside it projects for the scan to see

arms.name: M-ISVAR-NATIVE-BLIND
arms.note: target code pasted as a string is not read, so the fix strips the metadata a `__cpp__` / `Syntax.code` / `@:functionCode` access needs, and only the native build fails

arms.name: M-DSN-UNSEEN-DROPPED
arms.note: no narrowing is ever marked invisible to the compiler, so dead-safe-nav rewrites a Bool-local / alias / `?.`-comparison proof to `.` under null-safety and the build breaks

arms.name: M-DSN-UNSEEN-ALL
arms.note: a direct `== null` / `!= null` guard counts as invisible too, so dead-safe-nav declines the fix the compiler would accept

arms.name: M-DSN-JOIN-EITHER
arms.note: a join forgets that one arm proved the name only invisibly, so the fix lands on a path the compiler never narrowed

arms.name: M-DSN-RENARROW-HIDES
arms.note: an invisible re-narrowing hides a proof the compiler already has, so an accepted fix is declined

arms.name: M-DSN-ASSIGN-KEEPS-UNSEEN
arms.note: a non-null assignment no longer makes the proof visible, so the fix after `x = new T()` is declined

arms.name: M-DSN-TRY-KEEPS-ALL
arms.note: a proof made inside a `try` stays visible past it, so the `.` rewrite after the try does not compile

arms.name: M-DSN-TRY-HIDES-ALL
arms.find: final kept: Array<String> = visibleUnwritten(state, node, ctx);
arms.note: a proof made before a `try` is hidden past it, so an accepted fix is declined

arms.name: M-DSN-LONE-ARM-KEEPS-BODY
arms.note: what the body of a lone surviving `if` arm proved stays visible past the `if`, so the `.` rewrite does not compile

arms.name: M-DSN-LONE-ARM-HIDES-ALL
arms.find: final elseKept: Array<String> = elseArm == null ? visibleIn(elseState) : visibleUnwritten(elseState, elseArm, ctx);
arms.note: the condition's own narrowing is hidden past a lone surviving arm, so the fix after `if (x == null || b) return;`-style guards is declined

arms.name: M-DSN-JOIN-HIDES-ALL
arms.note: every join hides its proof, so two live arms that each narrow visibly lose their fix

arms.name: M-DSN-LONE-BRANCH-KEEPS-BODY
arms.note: what a lone live `switch` branch proved stays visible past the switch, so the `.` rewrite does not compile

arms.name: M-DSN-OWNS-NONE
arms.note: no construct keeps what its children proved, so an assignment inside a call argument loses a fix the compiler accepts

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-BINDER-BLIND
arms.find: final bound: Array<String> = ctx.selfScopeDeclKinds.contains(kind) ? boundNames(node, ctx) : [];
arms.note: a loop binder no longer shadows the outer name, so the outer non-null proof reaches `x?.f` on the binder and the fix / dead-fallback deletion crashes at runtime on a null element

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-CHILD-BINDER-BLIND
arms.note: a key-value loop's VALUE binder no longer shadows, so `for (k => x in m)` inherits the outer `x` proof

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-CASE-BINDER-BLIND
arms.note: a case capture no longer shadows, so `case x:` / `case var x:` inherit the outer proof

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-CATCH-BINDER-BLIND
arms.note: a catch variable no longer shadows, so `catch (x:Dynamic)` inherits the outer proof

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-SHADOW-NO-RESTORE
arms.note: the outer fact is never restored past a shadowing scope, so the fix after the loop is lost

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-SHADOW-RESTORES-WRITTEN
arms.note: the outer fact is restored even when the construct writes the name, so a null written by the iterable is read as non-null

arms.name: M-FOLD-FACTS-OPERAND
arms.note: an operand the binding leaves unproven is never asked of the compiler's facts, so a construct only they type stays report-only (fold) or unreported (the negation family)

arms.name: M-PSE-USING-MODULE-WIDE
arms.note: a using of a module weighs only the type named after it, not its sub-types

arms.name: M-PSE-USING-ALIAS-HOST
arms.note: a typedef in a used module is read as a type with no statics instead of the class it aliases

arms.name: M-PSE-USING-SELF-MODULE
arms.find: worse(verdict, supplied(module, module, method, symbols, file))
arms.note: the configured module's own using is not weighed, so its other types go unchecked

arms.name: M-OPERAND-MEMBER-SCOPE-LOST
arms.note: a member's written type is bound in the READING file instead of the declaring one

arms.name: M-OPERAND-MEMBER-CUT
arms.note: no member read or call types an operand

arms.name: M-OPERAND-METHOD-PARAMS-IGNORED
arms.note: a method's own type parameters do not shadow a type of the same name in its return type

arms.name: M-OPERAND-STATIC-RECEIVER-CUT
arms.note: a type name never serves as a receiver, so no static access types an operand

arms.name: M-OPERAND-LOCAL-CALL-CUT
arms.note: a call to a function this file declares is never typed by its return type

arms.name: M-OPERAND-CASE-CAPTURE
arms.note: a `case` capture between a read and the binding the walk found is not seen, so the read binds to the outer declaration

arms.name: M-OPERAND-CASE-CAPTURE-INSIDE
arms.note: a binding declared inside the capturing branch is refused too, though it shadows the capture

arms.name: M-OPERAND-OVERLOAD-SIGNATURE
arms.note: a call to an `@:overload`ed member is typed by the written signature alone

arms.name: M-OPERAND-MACRO-RETURN
arms.note: a call to a macro is typed by the macro's written return

arms.name: M-OPERAND-LOCAL-MACRO
arms.note: an unqualified call to the file's own macro or overloaded member is typed by its written return

arms.name: M-SWITCH-BARE-BODY-VERBATIM
arms.note: a case body is taken verbatim, so a branch whose `;` was elided before `else` arrives bare

arms.name: M-SWITCH-TERMINATED-BODY-DOUBLED
arms.note: the terminator is appended even after a body that already ends in `;` or `}`

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-VALUE-FACT-BLIND
arms.note: a `m[k] != null` guard or a non-null write to `m[k]` proves nothing about a re-read of the same entry

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-VALUE-FACT-UNKILLED
arms.note: a value fact survives a call, a `new`, a write through a path and a loop's back edge

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-PREDICATE-BLIND
arms.note: a true call to a non-null predicate proves nothing about its argument

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-PREDICATE-UNCHECKED
arms.note: an overridable member is trusted as a non-null predicate

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-PREDICATE-TYPE-UNCHECKED
arms.note: a predicate argument counts whatever its written type, so an implicit @:from / @:to conversion into the parameter launders a null

arms.name: M-SWITCH-VALUES-NOT-DISTINCT
arms.note: two rungs testing one value tuple pass gate 9, so the switch carries a case the compiler reports unused

arms.name: M-SWITCH-UNKNOWN-VALUE-ACCEPTED
arms.note: a pattern whose value is not proved is keyed as empty instead of refusing the chain, so its distinctness is never established

arms.name: M-CASEVALUE-IMPLICIT-NOT-COUNTED
arms.note: an uninitialized counting enum-abstract value repeats the previous value instead of adding one

arms.name: M-CASEVALUE-NAMING-UNKNOWN
arms.note: an uninitialized String enum-abstract value is no longer read as its own name, so every chain testing one is refused

arms.name: M-SWITCH-PATTERN-EQ-OVERLOAD-IGNORED
arms.note: a pattern whose declaring abstract overloads == passes gate 10, and the switch bypasses the overload the chain called

arms.name: M-SWITCH-DISC-EQ-OVERLOAD-IGNORED
arms.note: a discriminant declared as an abstract overloading == passes gate 10, and the switch bypasses the overload the chain called

arms.name: M-SWITCH-ELSELESS-REFUSED
arms.note: no else-less chain may close with an empty case _, so a chain without a trailing else is never converted

arms.name: M-SWITCH-ELSELESS-GUARDED-ELSE
arms.note: a chain followed by a #if region carrying its else closes with case _, stranding the guarded else

arms.name: M-SWITCH-ELSELESS-ANY-HOST
arms.note: an else-less chain that is a brace-less body of another construct closes with case _ too

arms.name: M-SWITCH-ELSELESS-LAST-IN-VALUE-BLOCK
arms.note: an else-less chain ending a nested block, possibly its value, closes with case _

arms.name: M-SWITCH-FIX-REPORT-INDEX-FIRST
arms.note: the report-scoped index a --fix hands the check wins over the resolution index, so a constant declared outside the report scope is unprovable in fix though run proved it

arms.name: M-ELSELESS-FINAL-ELSE
arms.note: whatever follows an `else` is read as another `if` link, so `else while (b) x = 3;` becomes a branch guarded by the loop's condition

arms.name: M-OPERAND-NEW-CUT
arms.find: return at == null ? Unknown : writtenTier(node.name, at.from);
arms.note: a construction is no longer of the type it writes, so its operator and its toString go unproven

arms.name: M-CONST-EXPR-NO-NAMES
arms.find: if (node.kind == seams.identKind) return name != null && isConstantName(name);
arms.note: a reference to another constant is never constant

arms.name: M-CONST-EXPR-NO-OPERATORS
arms.find: final grouping: Bool = seams.operatorKinds.contains(node.kind) || node.kind == seams.parenKind;
arms.note: an operator over constants is not folded

arms.name: M-CONST-EXPR-NO-PARENS
arms.find: final grouping: Bool = seams.operatorKinds.contains(node.kind) || node.kind == seams.parenKind;
arms.note: a parenthesised constant is not seen through

arms.name: M-CONST-EXPR-ANY-OPERAND
arms.note: an operator with ONE constant operand is read as constant

arms.name: M-CONST-EXPR-INTERPOLATED
arms.note: an interpolated string is read as a plain literal

arms.name: M-OPSEL-REPORT-DROPPED
arms.note: a fix's report index is ignored, so an `@:op(!A)` declared in a sibling module is unseen by the fix that orients a ternary

arms.name: M-REACH-AUTOBUILD-IGNORED
arms.note: an @:autoBuild ancestor no longer keeps unused-public-member from deleting a method its macro may call

arms.name: M-BINDER-INITIALIZER-CUT
arms.note: an unannotated local is no longer typed by its initializer, so an operand it holds goes unproven

arms.name: M-BINDER-SELF-CUT
arms.note: the self reference is no longer its enclosing type, so `this.f` goes unproven

arms.name: M-BINDER-INHERITED-CUT
arms.note: a member the enclosing type inherits, read or called bare, goes unproven

arms.name: M-BINDER-EXTENSION-CUT
arms.note: a static extension call goes unproven

arms.name: M-BINDER-RESOLVE-CUT
arms.note: an abstract's @:op(a.b) field goes unproven

arms.name: M-BINDER-INHERITED-STATIC
arms.note: a supertype's static, which is not in scope bare, types the bare name an import binds

arms.name: M-BINDER-CLOSURE-UNRESOLVED
arms.note: an inherited member is read past a supertype link the index cannot resolve, where a covariant override may sit

arms.name: M-BINDER-RESOLVE-USING-SHADOW
arms.note: the @:op(a.b) resolver is taken although a using in scope declares a static of the field's name, which 4.3.7 binds first

arms.name: M-DEFLIT-NULL-DROPPED
arms.note: `null` is no default literal, so `!a ? x : null` is inverted under `keepDefaultElse`

arms.name: M-DEFLIT-FALSE-DROPPED
arms.note: `false` is no default literal, so `!a ? x : false` is inverted under `keepDefaultElse`

arms.name: M-DEFLIT-ZERO-DROPPED
arms.note: a numeric zero is no default literal, so `!a ? x : 0` is inverted under `keepDefaultElse`

arms.name: M-DEFLIT-EMPTY-STRING-DROPPED
arms.note: an empty string is no default literal, so `!a ? x : ""` is inverted under `keepDefaultElse`

arms.name: M-BINDER-LAMBDA-PARAM-CUT
arms.note: an untyped lambda parameter is never typed by the function type the lambda is expected to be

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-CUT
arms.note: a call argument expects no type, so a lambda passed to a member of the file types no parameter

arms.name: M-BINDER-ANNOTATION-CUT
arms.note: a declaration or an assigned binding written with a function type expects nothing of the lambda it holds

arms.name: M-BINDER-RETURN-CUT
arms.note: a returned lambda is never typed by the function type its function writes as its result

arms.name: M-BINDER-FIELD-CUT
arms.note: an object-literal field expects nothing of the lambda it holds

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-REST
arms.note: an argument past a rest parameter's position binds no parameter

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-SKIPPABLE
arms.note: a lambda after an optional or defaulted parameter is typed by the parameter at its position, which the call may have skipped

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-OVERLOAD
arms.note: a lambda passed to an @:overload member whose call selects no one signature is typed by the member's own, which the call may not select

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-TWIN
arms.note: a lambda passed to a member a #if declares twice is typed by one build's signature

arms.name: M-BINDER-ARGUMENT-SCOPE
arms.note: a callee parameter is bound where the CALL is, so the callee's own type parameter binds a namesake class

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-FROZEN-STALE
arms.find: if (last != null && lastFacts != null && sameReadState(last, state)) return lastFacts;
arms.replace: if (last != null && lastFacts != null) return lastFacts;
arms.note: a recording walk hands every visit the facts it froze first, so the replay answers what the state held at the first visit of the unit

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-MEMO-SEED-BLIND
arms.find: if (cache == null || seed != null || declaredNullable != null || typeSources != null) {
arms.replace: if (cache == null || declaredNullable != null || typeSources != null) {
arms.note: a seeded walk is answered from the seedless recording and loses every MaybeNull the seed makes

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-MEMO-DECLARED-BLIND
arms.find: if (cache == null || seed != null || declaredNullable != null || typeSources != null) {
arms.replace: if (cache == null || seed != null || typeSources != null) {
arms.note: a declaredNullable walk is answered from the seedless recording and loses the annotation seed

arms.name: M-NULLFLOW-MEMO-TYPES-BLIND
arms.find: if (cache == null || seed != null || declaredNullable != null || typeSources != null) {
arms.replace: if (cache == null || seed != null || declaredNullable != null) {
arms.note: a walk given the written types is answered from the recording made without them, so a non-null predicate call no longer narrows

arms.name: M-ACCESSOR-STORAGELESS-TRUE
arms.note: every accessor clause counts as storage-less, so a `null` / `default` slot leaves the field rules too

arms.name: M-CARRY-USING-DOOR-OFFSET
arms.note: the carry asks the door at declaration-relative offsets

arms.name: M-MEMBER-DOOR-SHADOW
arms.note: the std listing answers for a name a project type takes

arms.name: M-BINDER-CALLEE-MEMBER-OFF
arms.note: `recv.m(…)` selects no parameter list, so a lambda handed to a member of another file stays untyped

arms.name: M-BINDER-CALLEE-NEW-OFF
arms.note: a construction selects no parameter list, so a lambda handed to a constructor stays untyped

arms.name: M-BINDER-CALLEE-INHERITED-OFF
arms.note: a bare call to an inherited member selects no parameter list

arms.name: M-BINDER-CALLEE-LOCAL-OFF
arms.note: a call to a local function selects no parameter list

arms.name: M-BINDER-OWNER-BINDINGS-OFF
arms.find: : memberParams(binder, declared, ownerBindings(binder, receiver, owner, declared.host), 0, [], args);
arms.note: the receiver's type arguments bind nothing, so `Box<Use>.each`'s `T` stays unbound

arms.name: M-BINDER-LOCATED-HOST-OFF
arms.note: a callee's parameter type is bound in the calling file, where the callee's private type means nothing

arms.name: M-BINDER-METHOD-SHADOWS-OFF
arms.note: a method's own type parameter does not shadow its type's, so `Box<Use>.shadow<T>` reads `T` as `Use`

arms.name: M-BINDER-CALLEE-OVERLOAD
arms.find: final written: Null<CallSignature> = signature == m.signatures[0] ? null : signature;
arms.note: the `@:overload` signature a call selects is read as the member's own, so `three(1, c -> …)` types `c` by the own `(cb:(c:FlagOn) -> Void)`

arms.name: M-BINDER-ITERABLE-OFF
arms.note: a std Iterable parameter binds nothing, so `xs.iter(c -> …)`'s `c` stays untyped

arms.name: M-BINDER-ITERABLE-ANY-TYPE
arms.find: if (i < args.length && stdNamed(binder, path, binder._file, name))
arms.note: any generic type binds an Iterable's element, a haxe.ds.Vector included

arms.name: M-BINDER-OVERLOAD-SELECTED
arms.find: return candidates == null ? null : calls.select(candidates, passed)?.signature;
arms.note: a call to an `@:overload` member always reads its own signature, which the call may not select

arms.name: M-BINDER-OVERLOAD-OWN-BARE
arms.find: return member.hasOverloadMeta ? ownMemberParams(binder, member, args) : localParams(binder, fn);
arms.note: a bare call to an `@:overload` member of this file selects no parameter list

arms.name: M-BINDER-RETURN-ANNOTATION
arms.replace: final written: Null<String> = [for (c in fn.children) if ((_shape.typeAnnotationKinds ?? []).contains(c.kind)) _source.substring(c.span?.from ?? 0, c.span?.to ?? 0)].pop();
arms.note: a function's result is its last annotation child, so a type parameter's bound beside no return type types the lambda it returns

arms.name: M-BINDER-LOCAL-CALL-ANNOTATION
arms.note: a local function's result is its last annotation child, so a call of one written with no return type is its type parameter's bound

arms.name: M-USING-STATIC-RECEIVER
arms.note: a static of the type a type expression names no longer binds first, so `Type.name(...)` keeps every `using` offering `name`

arms.name: M-USING-CONTEST-ANY
arms.note: any other `using` in scope contests the statement again, so redundant-import, hoist and sink refuse past a rival no access of the module shares

arms.name: M-USING-STATIC-SHADOW
arms.find: if (!ValueDoors.bindsNoValue(recv, typeName, span, fi, tree, _plugin.refShape(), _file, index)) return Unknown;
arms.note: a value spelled like a type — an inherited field, a module-level field, an imported static or constructor — reads as that type, so its static seems to bind and a `using` the value needs is deleted

arms.name: M-PROPSTORE-READS-BLIND
arms.note: no read is ever found, so a property something reads is offered a never read access, which breaks every read

arms.name: M-PROPSTORE-WRITE-TARGETS-OFF
arms.note: a plain write counts as a read, so a property only ever written through its setter is never offered the never read access

arms.name: M-PROPSTORE-COMPOUND-AS-WRITE
arms.note: a compound assignment or an increment counts as a pure write, although it reads the property first

arms.name: M-PROPSTORE-MENTION-BLIND
arms.note: a setter is judged unstored without reading its body, so one that stores its property is reported

arms.name: M-PROPSTORE-BODILESS-ADMITTED
arms.note: a setter declared without a body is read as one that stores nothing, so an abstract or extern accessor is reported

arms.name: M-REFLECT-ENUM-BLIND
arms.note: no scope is ever seen enumerating an object, so a printing call no longer declines the fix

arms.name: M-REFLECT-ENUM-COMPUTED-BLIND
arms.note: a member read by a computed name is taken for a literal one, so it no longer counts as enumerating

arms.name: M-REFLECT-ENUM-LITERAL-ENUMERATES
arms.note: a member read by a literal name counts as enumerating, so a read of another member declines the fix

arms.name: M-REFLECT-ENUM-STD-INCLUDED
arms.note: the std joins the enumeration scan, and since it spells every enumerating call itself the fix is declined in every real run

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-NO-PROOF
arms.find: if (rest.terms.empty() && rest.constant >= 0 && unwritten(bound, ctx) && uncalled(bound, path, ctx)) return true;
arms.note: no enclosing bound proves a start non-negative

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-ELSE-AS-THEN
arms.find: facts(kids[0], slot == 1, region, kids[0].span, ctx, out);
arms.replace: facts(kids[0], true, region, kids[0].span, ctx, out);
arms.note: a ternary or if condition bounds its else branch as if it held there

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-WRITES-IGNORED
arms.note: a write in the guarded region to an operand of the bound leaves it standing

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-TEXT-ATOMS
arms.find: final key: Null<String> = WriteSites.accessPath(node, ctx.tree, seams.shape);
arms.note: an operand is keyed by its spelling, so a shadowing local is the guard's operand

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-NO-BARRIER
arms.note: a bound above a function literal reaches its body

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-CALLS-IGNORED
arms.note: a call in the guarded region never voids a bound, so a field, a static or a member a callee changes keeps a proof it lost

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-LOCALS-VOLATILE
arms.note: every operand reads as storage a call may change, so a call beside a bound over locals voids a proof that holds

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-STRING-MUTABLE
arms.note: a member read off an immutable local reads as changeable by a call, so a local string's length loses its bound across any call

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-EFFECT-FREE-IGNORED
arms.note: an effect-free std call voids a bound as any call does, so a proof that holds is lost

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-DEFERRED-CALLS-RUN
arms.note: a call inside a function literal of the region reads as run there, so a literal that is only defined voids a bound

arms.name: M-ORDERGUARD-CAUSE-UNSCANNED
arms.note: a write or call in the condition that proved a bound, after its comparison, is never seen, so the bound outlives the change

arms.name: M-TAILMERGE-NORM-ONLY
arms.note: statement identity is decided by whitespace-normalized source alone, so two calls differing only INSIDE a string literal read as the same statement and a tail that is not duplicated is reported

arms.name: M-ENUM-ABSTRACT-LEGACY-META
arms.note: a legacy `@:enum abstract` reads as a plain abstract, so a move takes its values away from a file that read them through a module statement

arms.name: M-ENUM-ABSTRACT-PREFIX-KEYWORD
arms.note: an abstract led by a guarded `enum` keyword reads as a plain abstract, so a move takes its values away from a file that read them through a module statement

arms.name: M-PURITY-PLAIN-VALUE-KINDS
arms.note: a field read, an index read or a call passes as a plain value because only its children are checked, so a condition that runs a getter is dropped

arms.name: M-PURITY-PLAIN-VALUE-GETTER
arms.note: a bare identifier naming a property of the enclosing type whose getter runs code passes as a plain value, so a condition that reads it is dropped

arms.name: M-HCBT-STATEMENT-POSITION
arms.note: an if that is a brace-less loop body or a value is a chain head, so the shared run is written outside the loop body's statement and runs once instead of every iteration, or lands inside an expression

arms.name: M-HCBH-NO-EXIT
arms.note: a head holding a return, throw, break or continue is moved before the if, so the exit runs ahead of the condition and the branches' own code

arms.name: M-PURITY-STATIC-GETTER
arms.note: a property read through the name of its own type is taken for a plain field, so a condition that runs the getter is moved past a head that reads what the getter changes

arms.name: M-HCBH-HELD-LOCAL
arms.note: a local a called function literal rewrites is taken for unchanged, so a head that calls it runs ahead of a condition reading the old value

arms.name: M-HCBH-INERT-CALL
arms.note: a call in the head is taken for inert, so a condition reading a field the call writes runs after the new value is set

arms.name: M-HCBH-COND-READS-WRITE
arms.find: if (reads.exists(r -> WriteSites.mayOverlap(path, r, false))) return false;
arms.note: a head writing a local a condition reads through a name the held-locals gate did not clear is moved ahead of the condition, which then sees the new value

arms.name: M-HCBH-EFFECTFUL-COND
arms.note: a condition that calls a function, assigns or runs a property getter is taken for pure, so a head that reads state those effects change runs ahead of them

arms.name: M-HCBH-CONSTANT-DECL
arms.note: any head may jump over a condition with a side effect, not only constant local declarations

arms.name: M-HCBH-DECL-CAPTURE
arms.note: a local the head declares leaves its branch and shadows the same spelling a condition or the code after the chain reads

arms.name: M-HCBH-SHORTEN
arms.note: a shared prefix the gates refuse is moved whole instead of shortened from its end to the part that may move

arms.name: M-HCBT-NESTED-ALL-OR-NOTHING
arms.note: a chain nested in a chain being rewritten applies its edits too, so the outer rewrite swallows some of them and keeps others: a call vanishes, or runs a second time

arms.name: M-HCBT-SUPPRESSED
arms.note: fix rewrites every chain scan finds, not only the findings it was handed, so a chain inside a CHECKSTYLE:OFF region is rewritten as well

arms.name: M-HCBT-REPORT-ONLY-OUTER
arms.note: a report-only outer chain counts as one being rewritten, so the chain nested in it waits for a pass that never rewrites its parent and its tail is never moved

arms.name: M-OPERAND-SHAPE-COUNT-REDECLARED-IN-OWNER
arms.replace:
final FIELD_ACCESS_CHILD_COUNT: Int = 1;
	return node.children.length == WHILE_CHILD_COUNT;
arms.note: the loop-slot owner keeps its own field-access child count instead of asking NodeShape, so the operand-count guard finds a second copy in a file exempt from the slot guard
